title: Frontend: Projects dashboard — grid of project cards
description: Build the main dashboard page showing all user projects as a responsive card grid with a 'New Project' button.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders all user projects as cards in a responsive grid
Empty state with CTA when no projects exist
'New Project' button opens the create project modal

steps.details: Create src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx. Use useQuery to fetch /api/projects. Show skeleton cards while loading. Render ProjectCard for each project in a CSS grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4). 'New Project' button in header triggers create modal.
If projects.length === 0, render an EmptyState component with an illustration, 'No projects yet' title, and 'Create your first project' button.
Login and navigate to dashboard. Verify projects display. Create a project — verify it appears. Check on mobile viewport — verify single column grid.
